title: docs(types,plugin-markdown): three texts list the serializer key list with `of` (objectui#10337)
body:
Refs #10337
Clause-②: no. These are comments only, with no type or runtime change. PM ACCEPT.

The card stays open after this PR. Its governed row, `skills/objectui/guides/plugin-development.md`, is not touched here: it needs the governed route, and open PRs objectui#10268 and objectui#8941 both edit that file. It stays on the card as residue.

## What changed

`manifestFromConfigs` in `packages/sdui-parser/src/index.ts` forwards `of` for each input, and has since objectui#8067. Three texts still said the serializer forwards six keys and listed them without `of`. Each one now uses the uncounted wording already in `ComponentInput`'s docblock in `packages/types/src/base.ts`, "a fixed key list per input, `of` included since objectui#8067", and lists every key: `name`, `type`, `of`, `required`, `enum`, `binding`, `description`.

| site | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `packages/types/src/widget.ts`, clause 2 of the `WidgetInput` divergence docblock | "forwards six keys (`name`, `type`, `required`, …)" | "forwards a fixed key list per input, `of` included since objectui#8067 (`name`, `type`, `of`, …)" |
| `packages/plugin-markdown/src/index.test.ts`, the `no longer authors inputType` case | "serializer forwards six keys — `name`, `type`, `required`, …" | same uncounted wording |
| `packages/types/src/__tests__/component-input-retired-constraint-keys.test.ts`, header "What was measured" | "exactly six keys per input — `name`, `type`, `required`, …" | same uncounted wording |

No conclusion changes. Each text argues that a retired key cannot reach the published manifest, and that still holds because none of the retired keys is `of`. What was wrong was the list: it told readers that `of` is not published, and it is.

Changeset: `.changeset/10337-widget-input-serializer-key-list.md`, `@object-ui/types` patch. The `widget.ts` docblock is published source and ships in the `.d.ts`. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` counts the plugin-markdown test file as published source too, and it passes with this one changeset.

## Verification (at `2f6064050`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/component-input-retired-constraint-keys.test.ts packages/plugin-markdown/src/index.test.ts packages/types/src/__tests__/component-input-retired-keys-7493.test.ts`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 45 passed (45)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` passed, then `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ packages/plugin-markdown/`: `Test Files 229 passed (229)`, `Tests 5092 passed (5092)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-markdown type-check`: exit 0, after the dependency closure was built with `pnpm --filter "@object-ui/plugin-markdown^..." build`.
- Lint was narrowed to the three edited files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json`. It checked 3 files and found 0 errors and 3 warnings, all older `no-explicit-any` hits in `plugin-markdown/src/index.test.ts` that this PR did not add. `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions`/`projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and a comment-only diff cannot change results for files it does not touch. The full-repo `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the 4 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- Control-byte scan of the edited files: no hits.

## Acceptance notes

- This PR does not touch `component-input-retired-keys-7493.test.ts`. It already records the change as history: six keys "at the time of the retirement", with objectui#8067 adding a seventh, `of`.
- The search `git grep -nEi 'six keys'` over `packages` and `skills` still returns many hits. The card lists them as other six-key shapes (chart relay, D3 findings, `AdminScope`, and others) that have nothing to do with this issue. On `origin/main` `8c10f4f71`, the only hits about this serializer were the three fixed here plus the governed skills-guide row.
